note: Registered Z3 consumer and RID matrix (0.24 G1). scripts/test_z3_hermetic.py checks this file against the csproj item list, the asset verifier, every workflow, and every registered test project; tests/Shared/Z3ConsumerGuardTests.cs reads it at run time in every registered test host.

bootstrap.source: Checksum-pinned upstream Z3Prover/z3 4.15.7 archives; every extracted output is then verified against the asset pins. This is the only acquisition path for builds, tests, and packing. Builds never download: ValidateZ3Assets fails when an asset is missing or wrong.

unsupportedRids.reason: Upstream's x64-osx archive contains an arm64 binary; Intel macOS is unsupported for verification. A test host on this RID fails Z3ConsumerGuardTests instead of skipping.
.NET 10 has no x86 SDK. The asset stays pinned in the asset manifest but is never copied to build output or packed.

testHosts.projects: Every project in eng/test-manifest.json. Each one references Calor.Compiler directly or transitively and links the guard.

matrix.coverage: Full suites of 11 manifest projects, with check_trx.py inventory enforcement. Calor.Ids.Tests runs in the id-validation job and Calor.Performance.Tests in performance.yml; publish-nuget.yml's test job runs all 13 before a release.
